bounds: One existing code; original term 0, 1, 7, 31 or 32 days; one repair family and one redemption. Admissibility abstracts exact label, production identity, expiry, disabled state, catalog, single-use capacity and absence of a prior grant. No mint operation. Safety-only finite abstraction; production permissions, actual PostgreSQL row-lock races and redemption/entitlement effects remain separate acceptance gates. The source PGlite suite executes selection/update/rollback SQL, but is not mechanical model refinement. No liveness claim.
